verdict.rationale: The only routing-related evidence is a community report that SolidStart has routing, and that report criticizes it as very slow with no workaround. That shows some routing exists in the Solid ecosystem, but nothing confirms a dedicated official router or describes how it integrates with the framework. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an official routing library, evidence that it is maintained by the Solid team, details of how it integrates (nested routes, data loading, SSR), and positive hands-on corroboration.
